evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's official Planning Committee public reports pack for 29 June 2015 contains application 15/0185/03 for land to the rear of the former Crawford Hotel, Alphington Road, Exeter. The indexed official PDF text includes a 1:1000 Ordnance Survey-based site map labelling Crawford Hotel (PH) and describes the site as directly to the rear of the former Crawford Hotel, locally listed building. Direct retrieval of the PDF payload through the available channel returned HTTP 403, and the indexed record exposes no record-bound Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinate sequence or downloadable physical building-footprint geometry. No geometry was inferred from the map image or site context.

field_evidence.footprint: Official indexed PDF text reports a 1:1000 OS-based map, but no record-bound Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates are exposed; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403.
field_evidence.type_use: The official record explicitly identifies the former Crawford Hotel and map label Crawford Hotel (PH), direct evidence of former hotel/public-house building use.
field_evidence.identity: Application 15/0185/03 is located on land to the rear of former Crawford Hotel, Alphington Road, Exeter.
